context: Synthetic ADAS labeling-service demo. Consumers needed one service-local convenience helper for calculating the square-pixel area of an annotation box without recreating coordinate arithmetic or bypassing the existing governed validator.
decision: Add calculate_box_area as a Python standard-library package function. Delegate complete annotation validation to validate_annotation before reading the box, then return (x_max - x_min) * (y_max - y_min). Propagate existing validation exceptions unchanged and do not mutate the annotation or add an area field.
rationale: LOCAL-LBL-DEMO-001 revision 1 approves the service-only helper. ADR-0001 and ADAS-LBL-001 revision 3 define integer half-open pixel edges, so no inclusive-endpoint adjustment is valid. Reusing the existing validator preserves the applicable ADAS-LBL-002 revision 2 provenance checks and ADAS-LBL-003 revision 1 ontology and class checks without duplicating governed behavior.
alternatives: Duplicating validation inside the area helper was not selected because a second rule set could drift from the established annotation boundary.
Adding one to each extent was not selected because inclusive endpoint arithmetic conflicts with ADR-0001 half-open pixel edges.
Adding area to the annotation envelope or persisting it was not selected because the local approval does not change schema 1.0 or lineage.
Adding a dependency, web endpoint or command-line interface was not selected because the feature is a small in-process standard-library helper.
